scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/server build && bun run --cwd packages/client build && bun run build:docs-site
scripts.start:railway: (PORT=3000 bun run packages/server/dist/index.js &) && sleep 2 && bun packages/client/.output/server/index.mjs
scripts.build:docs-site: bun run scripts/build-docs-site-css.ts && bun run scripts/build-docs-site-releases.ts
scripts.build:verify: bun run build && bun run verify:production-client

scripts.test: bash -c 'export BAO_ENCRYPTION_KEY="${BAO_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-bao-test-encryption-key-32bytes}"; export BAO_ENABLE_AUTOMATION_VERIFY="${BAO_ENABLE_AUTOMATION_VERIFY:-true}"; export BAO_ALLOW_AUTOMATION_PRIVATE_HOSTS="${BAO_ALLOW_AUTOMATION_PRIVATE_HOSTS:-true}"; if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then if [ -z "${PLAYWRIGHT_HOST_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE:-}" ]; then export PLAYWRIGHT_HOST_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE="$(bun -e "import { arch, platform, release } from \"node:os\"; import { resolvePlaywrightHostPlatformOverride } from \"./packages/shared/src/utils/playwright-browsers-path.ts\"; process.stdout.write(resolvePlaywrightHostPlatformOverride(platform(), arch(), release()) ?? \"\");")"; fi; case "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-}" in *cursor-sandbox-cache*) unset PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH ;; esac; fi; bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd packages/server test && bun run --cwd packages/scraper test && bun run --cwd packages/client test && bun test ./scripts'
scripts.audit:integration: bun run audit:official-llms && bun run verify:pages
scripts.audit:stack-versions: for pkg in bun nuxt tailwindcss daisyui elysia @elysiajs/eden drizzle-orm drizzle-kit @tauri-apps/cli @tauri-apps/api; do printf "%s\t" "$pkg"; bunx npm view "$pkg" version; done

scripts.validate:alignment: bun run validate:stack-alignment && bun run validate:ui-layout-tokens && bun run validate:daisyui-contracts
scripts.audit:full: bun ci && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run ci:alignment && bun run audit:integration && bun run release:verify
